decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping quickly into big threats by utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber. By generating massive amounts of mana and playing multiple lands per turn, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces to bring out powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with its ability to tutor for key pieces, replay lands for additional value, and create explosive plays that can quickly seal the game.

This deck focuses on generating immense amounts of mana quickly to cast powerful spells, primarily Primeval Titan. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to ramp up mana production, while also employing land tutors like Expedition Map and Tolaria West to search for key lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck aims to assemble the Amulet Titan combo as quickly as possible to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and powerful land triggers.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to cast Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands multiple times per turn, the deck can generate enough mana to combo off and win the game through landfall triggers and attacking with powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Relic of Progenitus helps to disrupt opponent's strategies while ensuring the combo can go off smoothly.

This deck utilizes the synergy between ramping up your mana with cards like Azusa, Arboreal Grazer, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and the key combo pieces Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to quickly overwhelm your opponent with massive creatures and landfall triggers. By having multiple ways to tutor for your combo pieces with cards like Expedition Map and Summoner's Pact, as well as utility lands like Urza's Saga and Vesuva, you can consistently assemble your win condition while maintaining a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure early in the game with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike to finish off the opponent. Cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Skullcrack disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Boros Charm provides flexibility in both damage and protection. The deck aims to win before the opponent can stabilize, making it a fast and relentless aggro deck.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible using cheap, efficient creatures and burn spells. By curving out with low-cost threats like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, while also continuously applying pressure with spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze helps to punish opponents for playing non-creature spells or developing their board, ensuring that the pressure is maintained throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing powerful red cards like Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, and Eidolon of the Great Revel, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The deck is focused on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, using a mix of burn spells and creature aggression to pressure the opponent and finish the game before they have a chance to recover.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and utilizing cascade mechanics to cheat out powerful spells for free. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can generate value and tempo advantage to close out the game swiftly. The deck includes a mix of removal, counterspells, and efficient threats to disrupt the opponent's game plan while racing to victory. With a diverse mana base and access to a variety of powerful spells, this deck aims to win through a combination of speed and disruption.

Achieving a low life total quickly in order to empower Death's Shadow and other powerful creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with discard spells and removal. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game, utilizing a mix of efficient threats and disruption spells to both control the board and finish the game quickly.

The deck focuses on presenting a fast and aggressive playstyle with a mix of creatures, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent with threats like Tarmogoyf, Siege Rhino, and Lingering Souls, while disrupting their game plan with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also has a strong equipment package with Stoneforge Mystic fetching Sword of Fire and Ice and Batterskull. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive strategy and ensure consistent casting of spells.

This deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards to fill up the graveyard and then casting Living End to bring back a large number of creatures from the graveyard at once. The key is to control the board early on with disruptive creatures like Grief and force opponents to discard key cards, while also setting up for a massive board presence with powerful creatures like Colossal Skyturtle and Striped Riverwinder. By utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will for cycling, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a huge comeback swing using Living End.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of Elementals and powerful spells to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The Elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef provide value and synergy with other cards in the deck. The inclusion of control spells like Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler help to manage the opponent's threats and disrupt their gameplay. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this Aggro - Affinity deck is to flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and use Cranial Plating to boost their power, allowing for quick and aggressive attacks. The deck utilizes cards like Frogmite, Memnite, and Ornithopter to quickly establish a strong board presence, while also including cards like Thought Monitor and Sojourner's Companion for card advantage and evasion. Urza's Saga is included for additional artifact synergy and ramp, while Relic of Progenitus helps disrupt opponent's graveyards. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and powerful artifacts.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent using low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. The creatures, such as Blistercoil Weird, Soul-Scar Mage, and Monastery Swiftspear, are all fast and efficient attackers. The deck also includes a suite of direct damage spells like Gut Shot, Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Skewer the Critics, which can quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck's card draw engine, Light Up the Stage, helps maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on. The land base is optimized for consistency and includes Fiery Islet and Sunbaked Canyon for additional draw power. Overall, the deck focuses on swift and relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back onto the battlefield to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Using cards like Grief and Solitude to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also using Ephemerate and Persist to recur creatures for additional value. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck aims to combo off quickly and efficiently, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to win the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost spells and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a mix of spells for removal, card draw, and counter magic to control the game while dealing damage efficiently. Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble help with card selection and keep the deck running smoothly. This deck aims to apply early pressure, maintain tempo, and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize, making it a fast-paced and powerful option in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on generating mana and drawing cards quickly to assemble a combo that wins the game in a single turn. The key cards enable players to reduce the cost of their spells and search for specific pieces of the combo, with the ultimate goal of casting a flurry of spells to generate enough storm count for a lethal Grapeshot. The deck is fast-paced and requires careful sequencing of spells to maximize efficiency and take advantage of the powerful card selection and mana acceleration provided by the deck's engine cards.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the necessary pieces to quickly ramp up mana and consistently cast Scapeshift to bring out Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Primeval Titan. By triggering Valakut's ability, the deck aims to deal large amounts of damage to the opponent's life total in a single turn. The deck includes various ramp spells such as Farseek and Sakura-Tribe Elder, as well as removal spells like Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's game plan and clear the way for the combo.
